subject: Syntera LLM workstream - request to pause demo / next steps
messages:
From: Alicia Ruiz <alicia.ruiz@syntera.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: product-ops@syntera.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Syntera LLM workstream sync?

Hi Kim and Marissa,

Quick update from my side — leadership pulled together an emergency roadmap review last night and asked teams to freeze any non-core work while we prioritize Q2 integrations. That means the LLM/inference evaluation we planned for next week needs to be put on hold for now. I know we were scheduled for an interactive demo on Apr 28; can you please pause any calendar invites for that date?

We still see value in Redwood long-term, but the product/exec team wants to focus on platform stability and a handful of integration projects through the end of May. There isn't a firm restart date yet — we'll aim to have a clearer window after the May 10 planning sync.

If it's helpful, I'd appreciate a one-page summary of the demo highlights and any low-effort integration notes we can keep on file. No big asks besides pausing the demo for now and keeping us in the loop.

Appreciate your flexibility.

Best,
Alicia Ruiz
VP Product, Syntera Inc.

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Ruiz <alicia.ruiz@syntera.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Syntera LLM workstream sync?

Hi Alicia — thanks for the heads up and totally understand the pause.

We'll remove the Apr 28 demo from our calendars and mark this opportunity as "on hold" in our pipeline. Per your note, I'll attach a short one-pager that summarizes the demo flow, integration touchpoints, and the minimal engineering lift required for an initial POC. I'll also include a draft SOW that outlines options so you have it when planning resumes.

If it helps product reviewers in the meantime, Marissa can do an asynchronous technical Q&A with your engineering lead (we can share a Loom walkthrough and a tiny test harness). Otherwise we'll check back after your May 10 planning sync — would it be OK if I follow up the week of May 12?

Also, do you have any timeline or gating criteria the execs mentioned that we should be aware of (e.g., must be part of the top 3 initiatives to restart)? Any color is helpful so we don't over-commit resources.

Thanks again, and safe travels if folks are on the road.

—Kim
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_one-pager.pdf; SOW_draft_v0.1.docx

Thanks Kim — that sounds perfect.

Quick clarifying note from the planning call: leadership is instituting a short "focus window" through the end of May where only pre-approved integrations move forward. The product team is drafting a prioritized list today; if Redwood isn't on that list we won't have capacity to engage until after the Q2 re-prioritization (likely late May / early June). No hard veto, just a capacity gate.

Please send the one-pager and SOW and we'll archive them in our procurement folder so we can pick things back up if we get a green light.

Appreciate the offer of an async tech review — we'll hold off on scheduling anything until we see the prioritized list. Following up the week of May 12 for a status check works for me.

Best,
Alicia
